title: Python: priority routing (SOS packets first)
description: Route SOS packets with highest priority
close_reason: Implementation required: Infrastructure exists (Priority.SOS in tx_queue, app_priority() helper, APP_PRIORITY mapping) but integration not wired. app_priority() is defined but never called. Node.send() and CoAP transport do not inspect packet content for priority. Needs: (1) logic to identify SOS packets (CoT subtype 0x20, /sos URI path), (2) call app_priority() or assign Priority.SOS, (3) propagate priority through stack to link.send(). This is a feature task, not a bug fix.
